content: Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) devices are recommended by the American Diabetes Association (ADA) for individuals using basal insulin therapy or those not on insulin therapy if they could benefit from improved glucose monitoring and insights. These devices, whether real-time CGM (rtCGM) or intermittently scanned CGM (isCGM), are particularly suitable for patients who rely solely on basal insulin or are managing their diabetes without insulin, as they provide enhanced understanding of glucose patterns and trends.
